verdict.rationale: Formant documents public APIs and SDKs for driving the platform programmatically: an Admin API (e.g. creating custom commands), query and ingestion APIs wrapped by the Python Cloud SDK, and a stated ability to programmatically ingest data and configure devices. A public GitHub toolkit for building on those APIs backs this up. The evidence shows few concrete endpoint details, and probes found no OpenAPI spec at common paths. Missing for 10: machine-readable OpenAPI/Swagger spec, detailed endpoint and auth reference evidence, independent hands-on corroboration of driving the platform end-to-end via API.
